title: Quantum Purity Amplification for Arbitrary Eigenstates and Multiple Outputs
summary: Quantum purity amplification (QPA) is the task of coherently transforming $n$ copies of a mixed state into high-fidelity copies of a chosen eigenstate. We develop a general theory of QPA for $n$ input copies, $m$ output copies, and arbitrary choices of target eigenstate, local dimension $d$, and input spectrum. We introduce the overhang-removal protocol, derive its all-site and one-site fidelities across output regimes, and show that it is optimal in several regimes, both asymptotically and nonasymptotically.
